strategy: When a failure is localized and reproducible, change only the failing boundary with bounded recovery; preserve fail-fast behavior for unrelated failures.

promotion.approval_scope: Promote this GROW execution strategy only; no repository push, merge, deploy, Netlify, paid API, or domain-authority transfer.

applicability: A failure boundary is identified from concrete evidence.
The correction can be bounded to the observed failure mode.
Unrelated failure classes remain fail-fast rather than being broadly retried or suppressed.
Relevant regression evidence is clean after the correction.
non_applicability: Design or UX acceptance where functional CI cannot prove parity.
Cases with unresolved confirmed failure or regression failure.
Situations requiring broad exception swallowing, silent fallback, or authority bypass.
next: Use this as the preferred failure-recovery strategy only when bounded_policy and applicability conditions match; new contradictory real outcome or regression failure reopens review.
